name: E12 Set-Conditional Swap Prediction
no_op: fixed zero logit and zero true gain; swap only if max logit exceeds frozen nonnegative threshold
architecture: 32 -> 32 GELU -> 1; identical1089 parameters; unused standardized feature slots zero
optimizer: Adam lr1e-3 betas(.9,.999) eps1e-8 weight_decay0 grad_clip1
batch: full batch of36 complete states; no independent-action sampling
loss: KL/soft-target cross entropy across512 swaps + no-op; gain normalized by per-state standard deviation; temperature0.3 fixed before training
label_scale: max(std(512 gains),1e-12), labels only; never inference feature
selection: maximize mean relative gain subject to degradation<=15% on validation; no-op fallback allowed; evaluate threshold0 separately
second_seed_rule: if any primary model passes validation, retrain only highest validation gain passing architecture with seed29, same budget, select threshold on validation
multi_rule: only if selected architecture passes validation with BOTH seeds; freeze both models first, evaluate their own trajectories at1/2/4; no new training states in this first-round decision study
scope: three single-step architectures first; no global solving, residual predictors, video generation, M64 sweep or fused kernels; phase2 expanded-state training deferred
